details: The postinstall hook (scripts/collect.js) runs a credential-harvesting payload on install. It executes `id` and `env` to capture the full environment, then reads credential files from the home directory and project root — including.aws/credentials,.aliyun/config.json,.cos_credential,.baidubce/credentials,.ossutilconfig,.docker/config.json,.kube/config, and.npmrc — and appends their contents to a log. It also queries cloud instance-metadata endpoints (169[.]254[.]169[.]254, 100[.]100[.]100[.]200, metadata[.]tencentyun[.]com, 169[.]254[.]80[.]80 at /latest/meta-data/) to harvest cloud IAM credentials. All collected data is staged into rt-probe.log and sysinfo.log written to /workspace, the project root, and the package directory. It additionally drops a persistence script 90-init-monitor.sh into.rules that records hostname/user/working-directory on each invocation.
